ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic word مَرْحَبًا (marhaban) mean? (1 mark)
   A. and upon you peace (the reply)
   B. good morning (the reply)
   C. I
   D. hello

2. What is the correct reply to shukran (thank you)? (1 mark)
   A. ismii
   B. marhaban
   C. ʿafwan
   D. maʿa s-salaama

3. What does the Arabic sentence أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My mother cooks.
   B. This is my father.
   C. This is my mother.
   D. I have a brother and a sister.

4. Which Arabic sentence means "The lamp is above the table." (1 mark)
   A. الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ
   B. الْقِطَّةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ
   C. الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ
   D. الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ

5. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا عِنْدَ الْبَابِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The book is on the table.
   B. The cat is under the bed.
   C. The lamp is above the table.
   D. I am at the door.

6. What does the Arabic word مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) mean? (1 mark)
   A. lamp
   B. chair
   C. cat
   D. room

7. What is phonological awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Knowing many words
   B. Noticing the sounds inside words
   C. Writing quickly
   D. Spelling only

8. How is the Arabic word اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. uktub
   B. ilmis anfaka
   C. ijlis
   D. ismaʿ

9. Which phrase would you say to a friend on a birthday? (1 mark)
   A. ʿiid miilaad saʿiid
   B. maʿa s-salaama
   C. kayfa haaluka?
   D. ʿafwan

10. What does the Arabic word ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ (irfaʿ yadaka) mean? (1 mark)
   A. read
   B. stand up
   C. listen
   D. raise your hand

11. What does the Arabic word بَارِدٌ (baarid) mean? (1 mark)
   A. weather
   B. rain
   C. hot
   D. cold

12. What does the Arabic sentence أَزْرَعُ شَجَرَةً mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is rainy.
   B. The weather is cold.
   C. The weather is hot.
   D. I plant a tree.

13. Which Arabic sentence means "The weather is cold." (1 mark)
   A. الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ
   B. الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ
   C. الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ
   D. الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ

14. Which sound does the Arabic letter م make? (1 mark)
   A. t as in tap
   B. d as in dog
   C. m as in mat
   D. l as in lamp

15. How do you read the syllable نُ? (1 mark)
   A. nu
   B. ni
   C. la
   D. bi

16. What does the word يَا (yaa) do in مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ? (1 mark)
   A. It means 'and'
   B. It calls a person, like 'O' or 'hey'
   C. It means 'in'
   D. It means 'my'

17. Which Arabic word means "father"? (1 mark)
   A. جَدَّةٌ
   B. عَمَّةٌ
   C. أُخْتٌ
   D. أَبٌ

18. What does the Arabic sentence أَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I visit my grandmother on Friday.
   B. I write with my hand.
   C. I help my mother on Saturday.
   D. I read a book on Sunday.

19. How is the Arabic word شَمْعَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. dawrii
   B. sharaab
   C. shamʿa
   D. hadiyya

20. Which Arabic word means "festival"? (1 mark)
   A. لَا
   B. رَقْصٌ
   C. حَلْوَى
   D. عِيدٌ

21. What does jism mean? (1 mark)
   A. body
   B. head
   C. hand
   D. heart

22. Which sound does the Arabic letter س make? (1 mark)
   A. s as in sun
   B. kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
   C. t as in tap
   D. j as in jug

23. What is the name of the Arabic letter ف? (1 mark)
   A. taa
   B. shiin
   C. Saad
   D. faa

24. Why do people use pictures to communicate? (1 mark)
   A. Pictures have no meaning
   B. Pictures are always words
   C. Pictures are only for children
   D. Pictures can be understood by people who speak different languages

25. Which Arabic word means "Monday"? (1 mark)
   A. غَدًا
   B. الثُّلَاثَاءُ
   C. الْيَوْمَ
   D. الِاثْنَيْنِ

26. Which Arabic word means "birthday"? (1 mark)
   A. أُغْنِيَةٌ
   B. لَا
   C. عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ
   D. صَدِيقٌ

27. Which style is old, angular and has straight lines? (1 mark)
   A. Kufic
   B. Naskh
   C. Diwani
   D. Ruqʿah

28. Which is a fault in handwriting? (1 mark)
   A. Letters on the baseline
   B. Wide gaps inside a word
   C. Even spaces between words
   D. Correct dots

29. Which Arabic word means "beautiful"? (1 mark)
   A. حَارٌّ
   B. جَمِيلٌ
   C. رِيحٌ
   D. سَمَاءٌ

30. Which Arabic word means "sky"? (1 mark)
   A. مِصْبَاحٌ
   B. سَمَاءٌ
   C. ذُرَةٌ
   D. تَحْتَ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into English: kulla ʿaamin wa-antum bi-khayr (2 marks)

32. List the members of the nuclear family in Arabic (English letters) with their meanings. Give at least four. (4 marks) (4 marks)

33. Explain why you should copy sounds carefully when learning Arabic words. (2 marks) (2 marks)

34. Write one Arabic sentence about a household item using a describing word, and translate it. (3 marks) (3 marks)

35. Translate into English: ashummu bi-anfii (2 marks)

36. Describe how to draw and label a household item. (4 marks) (4 marks)

37. Translate into English: kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm? (2 marks)

38. Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u fii l-hafla. (2 marks) (2 marks)

39. Describe how to solve a jumbled sentence. (3 marks) (3 marks)

40. Write a short conversation of three lines in which one friend asks about a party and the other answers. Use English letters. (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Translate into English: abii yaʿmalu (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad (2 marks)

43. Write three instructions about the body in Arabic sounds with meanings. (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Describe the steps for learning to write a new letter. (4 marks) (4 marks)

45. Put these syllables in order to make a family word and give its meaning: khaa + lun. (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Write five things or rooms found in a home in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

47. Translate into English: al-maa'u mufiid (2 marks)

48. Explain what it means to read with fluency and give two tips for reading fluently. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — hello
   مَرْحَبًا (marhaban) means hello.

2. C — ʿafwan
   ʿafwan means 'you are welcome' and is the polite reply to thanks.

3. A — My mother cooks.
   أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ (ummii tatbukhu) means: My mother cooks.

4. C — الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ
   الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ (al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila) means: The lamp is above the table.

5. D — I am at the door.
   أَنَا عِنْدَ الْبَابِ (anaa ʿinda l-baab) means: I am at the door.

6. A — lamp
   مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) means lamp.

7. B — Noticing the sounds inside words
   Phonological awareness is being aware of the separate sounds in words.

8. B — ilmis anfaka
   اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ is read ilmis anfaka and means touch your nose.

9. A — ʿiid miilaad saʿiid
   ʿiid miilaad saʿiid means 'Happy birthday'.

10. D — raise your hand
   ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ (irfaʿ yadaka) means raise your hand.

11. D — cold
   بَارِدٌ (baarid) means cold.

12. D — I plant a tree.
   أَزْرَعُ شَجَرَةً (azraʿu shajara) means: I plant a tree.

13. B — الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ
   الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ (al-jawwu baarid) means: The weather is cold.

14. C — m as in mat
   The letter م makes the sound m as in mat.

15. A — nu
   نُ is read nu.

16. B — It calls a person, like 'O' or 'hey'
   yaa is used to call someone by name.

17. D — أَبٌ
   أَبٌ (ab) means father.

18. D — I read a book on Sunday.
   أَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ (aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad) means: I read a book on Sunday.

19. C — shamʿa
   شَمْعَةٌ is read shamʿa and means candle.

20. D — عِيدٌ
   عِيدٌ (ʿiid) means festival.

21. A — body
   jism means body.

22. A — s as in sun
   The letter س makes the sound s as in sun.

23. D — faa
   The letter ف is called faa.

24. D — Pictures can be understood by people who speak different languages
   A picture can carry a message without words.

25. D — الِاثْنَيْنِ
   الِاثْنَيْنِ (al-ithnayn) means Monday.

26. C — عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ
   عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ (ʿiid miilaad) means birthday.

27. A — Kufic
   Kufic is an old angular style used for decoration and old manuscripts.

28. B — Wide gaps inside a word
   Wide gaps inside a word make it look like several words.

29. B — جَمِيلٌ
   جَمِيلٌ (jamiil) means beautiful.

30. B — سَمَاءٌ
   سَمَاءٌ (samaa') means sky.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: May you be well every year.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: ab (father), umm (mother), akh (brother), ukht (sister), ibn (son), bint (daughter).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning, up to 4.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: A small change in a sound can change the meaning, and careful copying makes you clear to the listener.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for change of meaning and 1 mark for being understood.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example al-baabu kabiir. The door is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct sentence, 1 mark for a matching describing word and 1 mark for the translation.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: I smell with my nose.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: Draw the item, colour it, write its Arabic name under it from right to left, write the meaning and check the spelling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: How is the weather today?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: The friends are at the party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 'the friends' and 1 mark for 'at the party'.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Find the word that names the item; find the position or describing word; put them together in the pattern and read aloud to check.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: A: hal ʿindaka hafla? B: naʿam, ʿindii hafla. A: mabruuk!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question, 1 mark for the answer and 1 mark for a suitable closing wish.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: My father works.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: I read a book on Sunday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: irfaʿ yadaka (raise your hand), ilmis anfaka (touch your nose), aghmiD ʿaynayka (close your eyes).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct instruction with meaning.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Trace the model; copy it several times from right to left; write it from memory and compare; add and check the dots.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: khaa-lun (mother's brother).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the meaning.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), hammaam (bathroom), hadiiqa (garden).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Water is useful (good for you).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fluency means reading smoothly at a steady speed with correct words. Tips: put a finger under each word; practise at slow and normal speed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for each tip.
